# Code of conduct

HexaScore is a community project: people rate, list, review and discuss games, movies, TV shows and books, and contribute code. This code of conduct applies to every project space: the GitHub repository (issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews), the community features on <https://hexascore.app> (reviews, comments, lists, edit suggestions, reports) and any other channel run for the project.

It is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), version 2.1.

## Our pledge

We want participation in HexaScore to be free of harassment for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and kind, including when you disagree about a score, a review or a pull request.
- Criticise ideas and work, not people; give and accept constructive feedback.
- Mark spoilers in reviews and comments.
- Contribute accurate catalogue data and cite sources for edit suggestions.
- Accept responsibility for mistakes, apologise to those affected and learn from them.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, slurs, threats, or sexualised language or imagery.
- Personal attacks, trolling and deliberately inflammatory comments.
- Publishing someone's private information (an address, an email, a real name behind a nickname) without explicit permission.
- Brigading or manipulating scores, fake accounts, coordinated rating campaigns and spam.
- Plagiarised reviews or copyrighted material posted without permission.
- Any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

The maintainer and the site's moderators clarify and enforce these standards. They may remove or edit comments, reviews, commits, issues and other contributions that break this code of conduct, and may warn, temporarily restrict or permanently ban a contributor or an account. On the site, moderation follows the community rules and the reporting tools in the app; a moderation decision explains its reason to the person affected.

| Impact | Usual action |
| --- | --- |
| Inappropriate language or unwelcome behaviour | A private, written warning explaining the problem |
| A single serious violation or repeated behaviour | A warning with consequences and a temporary restriction from interaction |
| Sustained inappropriate behaviour or harassment | A temporary ban |
| A pattern of violations, harassment of a person, or aggression toward groups | A permanent ban |

## Reporting

Report a problem on the site with the report button on the review, comment, list or profile. For the repository or anything else, email [support@hexascore.app](mailto:support@hexascore.app) with "Code of conduct" in the subject. Reports are handled promptly and confidentially; reporters are not retaliated against.
